about: Held-out probes for the second run of docs/evidence/category-picks. Written 2026-11-19 before any second-run model call, and committed before the run. None of these inputs is in the 48 probes of docs/evidence/category-list/hand-labels.json or in the normalize prompt. The draft prompt was not tuned on them. A pick is [general id, specific id or null], labeled by hand from data/categories.draft.json by the agent that revised the prompt. No model reply was seen for any of them.
kinds: brand (a brand or model name), general (a product with a general category and no specific one), gap (a product with no category), nonproduct (includes three nonsense inputs, labeled not_a_product/unclear).
brand_words_about: Brand and model words per brand probe, lowercase, matched as substrings of canonical_name. Same use as BRAND_WORDS in grade.ts.
